interface.name: manager
interface.description: This global interface represents a layout manager, which is responsible for managing window positioning.

request.name: register_
request.description: Register the client as a layout manager. The server will send layout manager events to this client.

arg.name: name
arg.summary: client-decided name of layout manager: brand, version, pid

request.name: unregister
request.description: Unregister the client from layout manager protocol.

event.name: surface
event.description: A new surface appeared on the server. The server notifies the registered client. The client should create an info object that will be used to query information about the surface.

request.name: info
request.description: Get/set information about the surface in layout manager protocol.

arg.name: id
arg.summary: ID of the new info object

event.name: new_layout
event.description: The server asks the client to create a new layout. The client should respond by creating a new surface with 'layout' role and name set to the provided one.

arg.name: name
arg.summary: server-decided name of the layout surface

interface.name: info
interface.description: An object associated with a surface that exchanges information related to the layout protocol between server and client.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The client informs the server that the info object was destroyed.

event.name: deleted
event.description: The server informs the client that the surface was deleted. Querying information from it is an error from now on. The client should destroy the info object.

request.name: role
request.description: The client assigns role to the surface. If the role is 'layout' it also sets name. For other roles name is irrelevant.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The client informs the server that the layout was destroyed. All windows on it become unmanaged.

event.name: deleted
event.description: The server informs the client that the layout was deleted. The client should free all resources, destroy its surface and destroy the object itself.

event.name: new_window
event.description: The server informs the client that a new window appears on this layout. The client should allocate space for it on the layout and ask to show it.

arg.name: name
arg.summary: server-decided name of the window for client's information

request.name: destroy
request.description: The client informs the server that it no longer manages this window.

event.name: deleted
event.description: The server informs the client that the window was deleted. The client should remove it from the layout and destroy it.

request.name: show
request.description: The client asks the server to map (show) the window.

request.name: hide
request.description: The client asks the server to unmap (hide) the window.

request.name: z_index
request.description: The client asks the server to reorder the windows so that windows with greater z-index are shown above those with the lower.

request.name: focus
request.description: The client asks the server to activate the window and deactivate the previously activated window. Also give the window keyboard focus.

request.name: geometry
request.description: The client asks the server to set the window's geometry (position and size).

arg.name: x
arg.summary: the x coordinate of the window

arg.name: y
arg.summary: the y coordinate of the window
